(define-fun left ((x Int) (y Int) (z Int)) Int (ite (and (>= (+ x y z) 1) (or (not (= y 0)) (not (>= (+ x z) 1)))) (+ x y) (+ x (* (- 1) y))))
(define-fun right ((x Int) (y Int) (z Int)) Int (ite (and (>= (+ x y z) 1) (or (not (= y 0)) (not (>= (+ x z) 1)))) (+ x y) (- x y)))
(declare-const x Int)
(declare-const y Int)
(declare-const z Int)
(assert (not (= (left x y z) (right x y z))))
